StoredAccount.description: The Account, as its `account` row holds it.

created.description: When it was made, as RFC 3339.

name.description: The name its person gave it, which a passkey shows.

StoredAccounts.description:
What an Accounts store holds, table by table: the schema of the
`accounts-store` format.

account.description: Its Account, the only one; none until its person makes it.

named_tokens.description: The Account's Named tokens, each by its hash.

recovery_codes.description: The Account's recovery codes, each by its hash.

StoredNamedToken.description: One Named token, as its `named_tokens` row holds it.

created.description: When it was made, as RFC 3339.

name.description: Its name, unique in the Account.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of its value, in lowercase hex.

StoredPasskey.description:
One passkey, as its `passkeys` row holds it: what checks its
assertions, never its private key, which stays with its authenticator.

added.description: When it was added, as RFC 3339.

credential_id.description: Its credential ID, in unpadded base64url.

public_key.description:
Its public key, as the COSE key its registration gave, in unpadded
base64url.

StoredRecoveryCode.description: One recovery code, as its `recovery_codes` row holds it.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the code, in lowercase hex.

used.description:
When it was used, as RFC 3339; none while it is unused. A code is
used once.
